archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Modified for Trust & Real Estate

typography.rules: H1 up to text-2xl, H2 text-xl, highly legible on mobile. Tracking-tight for headings.

spacing_and_layout.mobile_container: w-full min-h-screen max-w-md mx-auto bg-gray-50 relative shadow-xl overflow-hidden
spacing_and_layout.gaps: gap-4 for sections, gap-2 for internal items

component_path.buttons: rounded-xl font-semibold py-3.5 flex justify-center items-center active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform
component_path.property_card: rounded-2xl bg-white border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm flex flex-col relative
component_path.filter_chips: rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm whitespace-nowrap border font-medium
component_path.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white border-t border-gray-200 py-3 flex justify-around z-50 pb-safe

image_urls.description: Featured modern apartment exterior for the home screen carousel.
Premium flat exterior for listing card.
Luxurious living room for property details image gallery.
Bright modern room for property details image gallery.
Indian family/owner portrait for owner contact card or user profile.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark gradients underneath (e.g. bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-owner-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI focusing strictly on a Mobile App experience. If building for web as a prototype, constrain the layout inside a mobile-sized container (w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen).
Create horizontal scrolling for filter chips (Buy, Rent, Budget, BHK) using flex, overflow-x-auto, snap-x, and hide scrollbar utilities.
Implement a sticky bottom Navigation Bar containing Home, Search, Saved, Chat, Profile.
The property detail page must have a sticky bottom CTA area featuring 'Contact Owner' and 'Schedule Visit' buttons.
Use Lucide-React for all icons. Ensure icons inside property cards are sized appropriately (e.g., w-4 h-4 text-gray-500).
Do NOT use any placeholder images; rely exclusively on the provided image_urls array.
All components should be written in .js (not .tsx) files.
Use the color palette specified, prioritizing Emerald Green (#059669) for primary buttons, active states, and trust signals like 'Verified'.
